verdict.rationale: Kit's API, and by extension its MCP server, can schedule one-off broadcast sends via `send_at`, and you can update or delete scheduled broadcasts. The pricing page also lists Visual Automations and RSS campaigns, which suggest automated, repeating email workflows. However, no evidence documents true recurring schedules (cron-style or repeat intervals) for jobs or workflows. RSS campaigns and automations appear only as one-line pricing bullets, with no detail on scheduling. Missing for 10: explicit recurring or cron-style scheduling, documentation of how RSS or automation recurrence works, scheduling of automations via API or MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
